steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each response needs a cause, an action that addresses it, evidence and a due date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Response with no cause
findings.fix: Write the cause before the action

findings.title: Action does not address the cause
findings.fix: Match the action to the cause

outcome.notChecked: Whether the action will work; findings outside the report.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] finding-02.md:12  Response with no cause.
       Fix: Write the cause before the action.
[medium] finding-05.md:19  Action does not address the cause.
       Fix: Match the action to the cause.
[low] finding-03.md:26  Missing due date.
       Fix: Set the due date.
Not checked: Whether the action will work; findings outside the report.
pros: Checks a response with no cause, an action that does not address the cause, evidence not in the records, and a missing due date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the action will work; findings outside the report.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-audit-finding-response skill on the records for this review.
